Commentary.Commentary: So that's it from us for this game. Youngsters are unleashing themselves on the big stage and new heroes are emerging on a consistent basis. We hope you enjoyed our coverage. Join us for India's quarter-final clash against Bangladesh as and when it takes place. Till then, goodbye and cheers!

India skipper, Prithvi Shaw, says that the bowlers did a really good job for the team and the openers carried on the good work. Feels that attitude and intensity matters a lot on the field and he is pleased with his boys. Reinstates the fact that they are playing Bangladesh in the quarter-finals. Ends by saying that they have 5-6 days to rest and will aim to keep on playing with authority.

Zimbabwe skipper, Liam Roche, says that that it was a team decision to bat first. Feels that it was a good batting track but they were not up to the mark. Mentions that they enjoyed the conditions though. Praises the Indian openers for their brilliant batting and congratulates them. States that he wants to play for the Zimbabwe academy in England and also has hopes of featuring in the senior team in future.

Man of the Match, Shubman Gill, says that it was a good wicket to bat on. Mentions that they capitalized on it and played most of the shots down the ground. Praises Rahul Dravid for his inspirational coaching. Smiles and ends saying that he enjoys batting with Desai.

Earlier, the Indian bowlers once again bowled the opposition out. Three times in three games to be precise, sums up how penetrative they have been throughout. The Men in Blue are going from strength-to-strength and are certainly firing on all cylinders. If they continue to play this way, it will be difficult to defeat them. The presentation is coming up in a while...

A near flawless performance from India has led them to annihilate the opposition without even breaking a sweat. The Men in Blue experimented with a new opening combination and the duo of Desai and Gill responded in style. They showed their range all around the park and kept on finding boundaries at will. Gill was especially eye-catching and gave a glimpse of the huge talent he has got. The Men in Red didn't find any answers and surrendered rather meekly.

FOUR! Gill finishes off in a commanding fashion! Just the way the Men in Blue would liked to have sign off. Length ball around off, Gill uses his feet and smacks it over the bowler for a boundary. Customary handshakes all around. INDIA WIN BY 10 WICKETS and they take the top position in Group B.
Overpitched outside off, smashed to deep cover for a run. India are one hit away.
Ooh.. movement! Shaping in prodigiously, Desai keeps it out somehow.
Short of a length ball outside off, crunched to sweeper cover for a single. The batsmen think about another run but it is not on. 150 up for India. This has been a brilliant opening stand.
Back of a length ball well outside off, Desai tries to go for the glory shot to take his team home but toe ends his flat-bat stroke to mid on.
Fullish delivery, Desai hangs back and taps it to mid-wicket.
Shortish delivery around off, Desai goes for a wild pull across the line but toe ends it to mid off.

FOUR! Streaky runs! A rare false shot in this innings. Fullish delivery around off, shaping in. Desai prods forward to counter it but gets an outside edge. The keeper dives to his right but the ball goes past him in a flash and through to the fence.
Bouncer on off, pulled through square leg for a run.
FOUR! A shot of a man whose confidence is sky high at the moment! Length ball in line of the stumps, Gill stands his ground and punches it on the up past mid on for a majestic boundary.
Nungu is back on.
Length ball, shaping in, tucked to the mid-wicket region for a run.
Back of a length outside off, dabbed to third man for a run.

Fifty for Harvik Desai! It has been a measured knock from him and he has impressed one and all with his astuteness. Short ball outside off, placed past the point region. The fielder in the deep slides to his right to keep it down to a couple.
FOUR! Banged in on the deck, a cross seam delivery, Desai lines it up and nails the pull through mid-wicket to find the ropes. Moves to 48 with that. His teammates in the pavilion cheer him on.
Length delivery on off, punched on the up to sweeper cover for a run.
Back of a length ball, steered uppishly past backward point for a run.
Wide! Same ball, same result!
Wide! Full ball outside the tramline, left alone.
Myers is back on.
Easy pickings again as the tossed up ball is driven to long off for a run.
Fullish ball, milked down to long off to rotate strike.
Leans ahead and plays the tossed up ball with the spin to covers.
Stays leg side of the ball and eases this one down to long off for a run.
Floated ball, defended solidly off the front foot.
Tossed up ball, played with an angled bat to point.
Drinks break. Meanwhile, Milton Shumba comes on for a bowl.
Very full on middle, creamed to long on for a run. India inching closer.

Brilliant fielding by the skipper! Low full toss on middle and leg, Desai just helps it in front of square leg. Roche in the deep covers a lot of ground to his left and dives full length to make a brilliant stop. The umpires check it upstairs but he is fine. Saves a couple for his side.
Full length ball attacking the stumps, clipped through wide mid on to rotate strike.
FOUR! A gift and duly accepted! Low full toss on the pads, bread and butter stuff for Gill as he flicks it nonchalantly through square leg to find the fence.
Low full toss around off, Shubman mistimes his drive to mid off.
Pitched up delivery around off, stroked crisply to wide mid off for a swift single.
FOUR! Treated with authority and disdain! Short ball on middle, no venom at all. Gill dismisses it from its presence to send it over wide mid on for a boundary.
Back of a length ball around off, Gill rises on his toes and clips it beautifully to the man at mid-wicket.
Short ball, no problem at all for Desai to pull it to deep mid-wicket to rotate strike.
Length ball on off, stays a touch low. Harvik adjusts in his crease to keep it out.
Fullish delivery, jagging in, pushed defensively to mid on.
Wide! Angling down the leg side, Desai fails to put bat on ball.
Short ball on off, pulled all along the ground to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Fullish ball around off, shaping in, defended compactly.
FOUR! Luck favours the brave! In the slot outside off, Desai swings at it with all his might but gets a thick outside edge past the keeper towards third man.
Good length delivery outside off, played defensively towards the off side.
Almost an action replay of the previous delivery as Desai taps it to the same region.
Overpitched around off, Harvik comes ahead and pushes it to mid off.
Back of a length outside off, Desai goes for a cut but chops it to backward point.
The Indian batsmen are taking a bit of a breather.
Shortish ball on off, Gill plays a short arm jab but the fielder at short mid-wicket is sharp as a hawk to stop it.
Back of a length outside off, punched firmly off the back foot but finds the man at short cover who dives to save certain runs for his side.
Full and sprayed on the pads, clipped through backward square leg for another couple.
Fuller in length, driven sweetly to the cover region.
Around the hips, tucked around the corner for a couple.
FOUR! Hit hard! Shortish ball, Gill stands tall and flat-bats it over the mid on fielder to find the fence.

FOUR! Shoddy stuff from Zimbabwe! They have lost all hope it feels. Shortish delivery outside off, Gill punches it towards short cover where the fielder dives to his left to stop the ball. Fires an unnecessary throw at the bowler's end. There is no one backing up and it results in four overthrows. Chimhinya has overstepped as well. Free Hit coming up...
Chimhinya to have a bowl now.
Low full toss around off, Gill goes for the heave but gets it off the inner half through square leg. A run taken.
Played to mid-wicket region by the batsman.

SIX! Fifty for Shubman Gill! He looked at ease from the word go and has played some eye-catching strokes throughout his innings. Short ball around off, sits up nicely for Gill. He stands tall and short-arm-jabs it over deep mid-wicket for a biggie. Raises his bat towards the dressing room and sinks in all the applause. Well played, young man.
Back of a length outside off, flayed through point for a single.
Very full outside off, swinging in. Desai plays it with an angled bat face towards backward point. Controlled his shot well.
Fullish delivery around off, Desai covers the line and blocks it nicely.
Nungu is back on.
Leans ahead and strokes it to the same region for a run.
Floated outside off, Gill strides forward and knocks it down to long off for a single.
Slower through the air, Shubman lunges forward in defense.
Spinning down the leg side, helped to the man at 45 to rotate strike.
Fullish ball on leg stump, pushed through mid on for a single.
Allows the ball to turn into him and clips it to the mid-wicket fielder.
Tossed up outside off, eased off the front foot to covers.
Fullish delivery around off, defended solidly off the front foot.
SIX! Picked the bones out of that one! Leg cutter on a short length. Desai reads it well and dumps it over deep mid-wicket for a maximum.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

Good game awareness! Short of a length outside off, Gill punches it through covers. The man at sweeper cover moves a lot of ground to his right. Some aggressive running between the batsmen allows the batsmen to come back for three runs.
Starts off with a slow delivery around off, Gill drives it nicely towards mid off.
Jonathan Conolly comes into the attack.
Floated delivery, knocked down to long on for a single.
Spinning into Desai who punches it down to long on to rotate strike.
Plays this one with the turn to the leg side.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot.
Tossed up outside off, Desai goes for the drive but slices it towards backward point.
On middle and leg, clipped to deep square leg for a single.
Powerplay 2 has been signalled. Maximum of 4 fielders are allowed outside the circle. Liam Roche is back into the attack as well.
Floated ball, eased down the pitch.
FOUR! Crunched! Zimbabwe are bowling too short and are paying the price for it. Outside off, Desai slaps it through extra cover for another boundary.
Fullish ball, stroked to long on for a single.
Flatter ball, punched with the angle to sweeper cover for a couple.
Played to mid-wicket region by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Short ball, pulled hard but straight to the man at mid-wicket.
Gill goes at this one with hard hands but mistimes it to mid off.
Slow through the air, defended watchfully.
FOUR! Three boundaries in the over already! Floated outside off, Gill caresses it through covers to find the ropes.
FOUR! Gill is dealing in boundaries! Uses his feet and whips it through mid-wicket to find the fence.
Driven through mid off by the batsman.

FOUR! Runs are coming thick and fast now! Short again, Gill makes use of the depth of the crease and punches it through extra cover. The mid off fielder gives it a long chase but fails to keep the ball in play.
Taun Harrison to roll his arm over now.
Straying on the pads, tucked to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Fractionally shorter, pulled to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Sits deep in the crease and punches it with the angle to short cover.
In line of the stumps, blocked watchfully.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
FOUR! Shot! Shorter in length, going away from Desai. He rocks back and cuts it through cover-point for a boundary.
Wesley Madhevere to have a bowl now.
FOUR! What timing! Tossed up on off, Gill punches it down the ground past mid on. The long on fielder hares to his left, slides but only comes second best. That kept on going. 15 from the over.
Wide! Down the leg side, Gill tries to flick it but misses and loses a bit of balance. The keeper fumbles which allows Gill to plant his back foot in the crease.
Good running! Taps this one with soft hands through mid-wicket and hares back for the second run.
FOUR! Gill is looking confident now! Fullish delivery down the leg side, Shubman kneels and sweeps it hard through fine leg to find the fence.
Spinning in, defended off the back foot towards mid-wicket.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
FOUR! Classical cover drive! Tossed up ball, Gill creams it through the line for a glorious boundary.
A catch but doesn't matter! Shortish ball around off, Desai looks to pull it hard across the line but toe ends it towards mid off where it is pouched by the fielder.
Wide! The Free Hit stays! Outside the tramline, Desai has nothing to do with it.

No ball! Goes really wide of the crease and angles in a back of a length ball substantially. Desai is cramped for room and gets an inside edge which just bounces over the stumps. Myers has overstepped, so a Free Hit coming up...
Short and width on offer, Harvik stands tall and places it to backward point.
Hangs back and works this one through mid-wicket for a run.
Fine leg comes up while deep cover in place now.
Wide! Length delivery well outside off, stays low. Gill chases it but misses.
On a length around off, played with soft hands to the off side.
FOUR! Cracking shot! Very full around off, Gill just punches it on the up through covers and away she whistles to the fence.
Starts off with a yorker around off, Gill is alert to it and digs it out towards covers.
Dion Myers comes into the attack.
Spinning into Desai who clips it to mid-wicket.
Tossed up ball, Desai strides forward to smother it down.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

FOUR! Different technique to deal with a short ball but proves to be effective. Outside off, spinning in. Desai comes on the front foot initially but then goes back. Cuts it with authority past point to pick up a boundary.
Spinning in sharply, Desai goes for the cut but is cramped for room. Ends up defending it down the track.
Fullish ball on middle, eased down to mid on for a single. This is the first run scored off Roche's bowling.
Back of a length on off, defended solidly off the back foot.
FOUR! Onto that one in a flash! Short ball outside off, sits up nicely for Desai. He swivels across and pulls it with aplomb over mid-wicket to find the fence.
FOUR! Desai finally gets off the mark! Short and room on offer, Desai stands tall and flays it square of the wicket on the off side for a boundary.
Fuller in length, Desai comes forward gingerly in order to defend it but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Well bowled! Back of a length ball, some extra bounce on that. Desai is caught in a tangle as he aims to fend it off but gloves it towards point.
Length ball around the hips, nudged through square leg to rotate strike.
Loopy ball on off, Harvik comes ahead and blocks it right under his eyes. Consecutive maidens for Roche and Desai is yet to get off the mark.
A bit short this time, punched off the back foot to cover-point.
Straighter one this time, tucked with the spin to square leg.
Flighted ball, kept out watchfully.
The batsman has pushed it to the cover region.
Tossed up ball, Desai lunges forward in defense.
On a length on middle, clipped off the back foot towards short mid-wicket.
Wide! Nungu loses his radar and slips this one down the leg side as Gill misses his flick. Ouch! The bowler has lost his balance and falls flat on the pitch. However, he is fine.
Fullish delivery, defended solidly off the front foot.
FOUR! First runs of the innings and it has come in grand style! Short and room on offer, Gill pounces on it and flays it uppishly through the point region for a rocketing boundary.
In the avenue of apprehension, holding its line. Gill plants his front foot across to allow it through. 9 dots in a row, good start for Zimbabwe.
Good length delivery, angling in, tucked with a closed bat face to mid-wicket.
Back of a length ball on off, Gill camps back and defends it solidly to the off side.
Nkosilathi Nungu to bowl with the second new ball from the other end. Only a wide slip in place.
Fraction short outside off, cut away to the man at backward point. The skipper starts off with a maiden.
Slow through the air this time, much more revs on this, Harvik leans ahead and presents a water-tight defense.
Sliding in again, played with the angle to mid-wicket.
Drifting towards the pads, Desai turns it to the man at 45.
A bit flatter and quicker on off, pushed off the back foot to covers.
Starts off with a tossed up ball on middle, defended besides the pitch on the leg side.

We are back for the chase. The umpires and the players make their way back to the middle. There is a change in the batting order. Two new openers for India. Shubman Gill to open the innings with Harvik Desai. Liam Roche to start off the proceedings with the ball. Here we go...
